summary: ReportWizard is a web-based multi-stage wizard used for generating custom and predefined reports, with rich step-by-step user interfaces. It supports both user-defined and locked/pre-defined reports, with roles for Placing Agency, Receiving Agency, and System Admin. The wizard handles creation, editing, running, and completion of report workflows, including name/description forms, stages with instructions and dynamic fields, validation, navigation, and output generation in multiple formats (HTML, PDF, Excel, CSV).
purpose: To guide users through a configurable, multi-step process for creating and running reports, collecting business data across stages and roles, and generating downloadable report files in various formats.

fields.name: cboReportType
fields.description: Report type selector (User Defined, Predefined All, Predefined PA, Predefined RA)

workflows.name: ReportWizard workflow
steps: If new: user enters name, description, selects report type (with admin options)
If wizard/run: wizard progresses through multiple stages, displaying instructions and stage fields (fields can be restricted by agency role)
Fields are dynamically rendered and may involve extra controls (e.g., calendar, dropdowns, filters)
Navigation: Previous, Next, GotoStage, Finish, Save & Close buttons, with hidden field tracking
On each stage, user's field values are validated and saved
On Finish, the wizard is marked complete, and report output is generated
Output report files in formats (HTML, PDF, Excel, CSV), linked for download
Wizard supports system messages, error panels, warnings, localization, and role-based controls

business_rules: Report type cannot be blank for sysadmin when creating new wizards
Fields may be restricted to PAOnly or RAOnly depending on user role
Locked reports are pre-defined and restrict editing
A report must be run for a minimum number of agencies (validation)
Localization is handled by session flags; French/English field and error text
validations: Report type required for sysadmin in 'new' mode
Minimum selection requirements for some fields (e.g., agency counts/cohorts)
calculations: Calendar controls process term-year-date fields for date ranges
File outputs are generated with unique filenames based on output format and mapped to Reports folder
conditions: SystemAdmin can select locked/predefined report types
system_behavior: Multi-stage navigation with left-nav for completed wizards
Dynamic rendering of UI controls and fields per stage
Output file creation, download links, and error handling
JavaScript setup for filters, movement between lists, validations
dependencies: WizardsController for database logic, SQL output, report completion
exceptions: Validation error messages displayed in user's locale
SQL/report generator errors handled and messaged
If no agencies/cohorts selected, error is shown
content_gaps: Field details (WizardField attributes) are referenced but not listed in full
Business logic for field filtering/chooser is described indirectly
Error message text and resources may vary (localization placeholders found)
Report output SQL, template structures, and full database schema are not included
No concrete examples of report types or business use cases beyond defined types
